bio.text: Jeff Bridges, a Democrat, has represented District 26 in the Colorado State Senate since 2019 and previously served in the Colorado House of Representatives (District 3) from 2017 to 2019.
According to Ballotpedia, he advanced from the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary for Colorado Treasurer and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
Bridges attended Arapahoe High School and received a Master of Divinity degree from Harvard University.
His professional experience includes working for U.S. Senator Ken Salazar, serving on the board of Colorado Conservation Voters, and serving as associate vice president at Union Theological Seminary.
